packageRules.description: Cargo: rewrite the full version in each manifest rather than add `=` pins, which would bind users of the published crates (balerix-api, balerix-plugin-sdk, plugins/common) to exact versions; the lockfiles already pin
A unit's base image ships only in a release, so its updates take a releasable type (docs/RELEASING.md)
Patch and digest updates merge themselves once required checks pass
Never automerge what reaches agents or the sandbox: a claude bump needs `mise run verify-claude` and `verify-questions` by hand (AGENTS.md), gh and claude are inherited by agents, nono is the sandbox
